top_stories.title: Amazon acquires key assets of AI startup Decart for reported $7.5B
top_stories.description: Amazon.com Inc. today announced plans to hire the technical staff of startup Decart.AI Inc. and acquire its core technology. The company didn’t disclose the terms of the deal. However, sources told Bloomberg that Amazon is paying about $7.5 billion. That’s nearly twice the valuation Decart reportedly received after its most recent funding round in May. top_stories.title: AI uncovers hidden bladder cancer warning signs years before diagnosis
top_stories.description: Scientists have developed an AI tool that can uncover hidden warning signs of bladder cancer up to five years before diagnosis, identifying 85% of cases in a major study involving nearly 70,000 patients. By revealing subtle patterns that conventional screening misses, the technology could help doctors detect cancer earlier and spare patients unnecessary invasive procedures.
